t1.text: Maintenance — the nine tabs that stay

removed.text:
REMOVED — 16 tabs down to 9

Brake Wear · Tire Wear — no feed, no rows, ever. Gone.

At Risk — folded into Home as alerts.

Arriving Soon — your call. Now a panel on Home.

Damage Reports + In-Transit Issues — merged into Driver Reports. A driver reporting damage and a driver reporting an issue are one act.

Severe Repairs — it was a filter, not an object. It is the red column on the board.

Pre-Flight DVIR — belongs to Safety. It surfaces on Home only when a defect is actually reported.

Active WOs stays as the full table; the board on Home is the same rows in kanban.

data.text:
EVERY NUMBER IN THESE PREVIEWS

Unit numbers and odometers are your real trucks, read live from Samsara at 13:20 CT today.

Work orders, repairs and parts rows are LAYOUT ONLY — you have no real maintenance records yet. They show what the screen does when your backfill lands. Nothing here was written to the database.
